front: When did Mzilikazi break with Shaka?
back: About 1822, after refusing to hand over raided cattle.

front: When did the Ndebele settle in south-western Zimbabwe?

back: Absorbing conquered or captured people into the nation, e.g. young men into the regiments.

front: Zansi, Enhla and Hole: who were they?
back: Zansi: Nguni from the south (highest). Enhla: Sotho/Tswana from the Highveld. Hole: mainly Shona incorporated in Zimbabwe (lowest).
The king lending cattle to loyal subjects to herd and use.
The annual Ndebele national ceremony renewing the king's authority.

front: When did Mzilikazi die and when was Lobengula installed?
back: Mzilikazi died in 1868; Lobengula was installed in 1870.
'Hill of the izinduna': where, by tradition, Mzilikazi punished the izinduna who installed Nkulumane.

front: Main reasons for the fall of the Ndebele state?
back: Succession dispute and internal tensions; concession seekers, the Rudd Concession and the Charter; defeat by the Company in 1893-94.

front: Where did Ndebele regiments live in peacetime?
back: In their own regimental towns, farming and herding under an induna.
